source_text: Fecerunt filii Israel malignum ante Deum. Memor esto Christum Iesum surrexisse — ne obliviscaris. Post duces oblivio parit malum.
pass_a_gloss: Did sons of-Israel evil before God. Mindful be Christ Jesus to-have-risen — lest you-forget. After leaders forgetfulness begets evil.
pass_b_english: [[The children of Israel did evil before God >> Bible:Judges 2:11]]. [[Remember Jesus Christ risen from the dead >> Bible:2 Timothy 2:8]] — do not forget. After the leaders, forgetfulness breeds evil.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
